description: A one-time code input that fills digit by digit from a suggestion above the keyboard, then verifies and shows the result.
overview:
`OtpAutofill` wraps an `InputOTP` and runs it through `idle`, `filling`, `verifying`, `verified` and `invalid` states. When the input is focused and empty, `OtpAutofillSuggestion` slides up above the keyboard with the incoming code; pressing it types the code one digit at a time.

When all digits are entered, `onVerify` runs and the slots dim while it is pending. A valid code turns the slots green and locks the input. An invalid code turns them red and shakes the row, then clears the input and refocuses it. Pasting or a system autofill of several digits plays the same digit-by-digit fill.
usage:
Pass `maxLength` and `onVerify`, which returns a boolean or a promise of one. Put `InputOTPGroup` and `InputOTPSlot`s inside `OtpAutofillInput`, and render an `OtpAutofillSuggestion` with the `code` your app received; it hides when `code` is empty.

The input sets `textContentType="oneTimeCode"` and the platform's one-time code `autoComplete`, so the system can also offer the code. `useOtpAutofill` returns `state`, `value`, `fill` and `inputRef` for custom controls.

examples.WrongCode: An incoming code that fails verification, showing the shake and reset.
examples.FourDigits: A four-digit code with its own suggestion.

parts.OtpAutofill: The root that holds the code and verification state.
parts.OtpAutofillInput: The `InputOTP` that shows each state and shakes on an invalid code.
parts.OtpAutofillSuggestion: A bar above the keyboard that fills the suggested code on press.

OtpAutofill.maxLength: Number of digits in the code.
OtpAutofill.onVerify: Checks a complete code; return `true` when it is valid.

OtpAutofillInput.containerClassName: Classes for the animated container around the input.

OtpAutofillSuggestion.code: The code to suggest, or `null` to hide the bar.
OtpAutofillSuggestion.source: Label above the code. Defaults to `From Messages`.
OtpAutofillSuggestion.portalHost: Name of a portal host to render into.

accessibility:
- `accessibilityLabel` on `OtpAutofillInput` is passed to the underlying text input.
- The suggestion bar has the `button` role.
- The input is read-only while filling, verifying and after a valid code.
notes:
- Invalid slots use `border-danger` with a `bg-danger` tint that is stronger in dark mode; verified slots use `border-success` and `bg-success-surface`.
- The suggestion bar uses `bg-surface-raised`, or `bg-surface-secondary` in dark mode, and sits on the keyboard or above the bottom safe area.
- Slide and shake animations respect the system reduce motion setting.
